criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First two lines stand alone and lead with the decision. Concrete noun/verb/stake, under the ~210-char cutoff.

criteria.name: Subject + decision load-bearing for AK
criteria.notes: Elected decision-owner; consequence names sector, dollar (~$600k), affected actors (APD, Thundercat, residents), timeframe (Aug 18).

criteria.name: Subject identification fidelity
criteria.notes: Full name + role + affiliation + district + explicit Anchorage tie, all matching the dossier.

criteria.name: Decision specificity + primary-source
criteria.notes: What+when+binary all named, traced to the dossier primary source cited inline, date in window.

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.notes: Genuine position grounded in the infrastructure-vs-model seam and the 2023 facial-recognition precedent; counter-case named proportionately.

criteria.name: Forward implication
criteria.notes: Names the Aug 18 vote, the binary to watch, and the prior AO 2026-27 vote as the tell.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, structural, Alaska-first. No influencer cadence, no hagiography.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: In word/char window, bio one sentence, but paragraph three was dense. Addressed post-scoring by splitting it, no wording changed.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Real, debatable question tied to the specific Aug 18 binary.

criteria.name: Credibility guard
criteria.notes: Decision treatment dominates minimal bio; single-outlet limitation disclosed openly, which reads as credibility-positive.

one_sentence_fix: Split the dense third paragraph so the source caveat, the 750-feed tech spec, the quote, and the binary each sit in their own block for easier mobile scanning.
_orchestrator_note: Scoring cycles used: 1 of a permitted 3. Above the 8.0 threshold on the first pass with no hard-fail. The weakest-criterion fix was applied after scoring as a paragraph break only; no wording, word count, or character count changed beyond one newline.
